# Whole original AST bounded validation

The wrapper imports the already reviewed fixed-command parent driver and adds relevant frontend targets. It never executes commands from captured metadata. `compile` runs only actual version checks and all-target compile; ordinary mode additionally checks formatting, shared type tests, selected integrations, the existing small native arithmetic/GHZ independent reference-column test, warnings-denied Clippy and rebuilds the CLI. Both toolchains share the one existing target and lock. The parent implementation is copied under the explicitly named `executed-driver.py.txt`; the wrapper and parent are both in the declared input map. The map is incomplete fixture/runtime closure, and no proof/full CI/release claim follows. Failed attempts remain separate.

The two existing 3000-file import stress cases are skipped. No new maximum-size quantum case is generated.
